desc: Implement count_after(o, e, next_par) using odd/even slot counts and factorial completion counts
Implement greedy unranking loop over positions with increasing candidate order and per-candidate count subtraction
Handle edge cases n=1, forced-parity start, and k out of range (return [])
Brute-force verify for all n in 1..8 and all k in 1..(total+2); assert match with sorted brute-force list, and confirm the three provided examples
Confirm no off-by-one in k accounting at position 0 vs later positions and that factorial counts never overflow/round (Python big ints)
Drop redundant alternative approaches (memoized DP, bipartite matching) now that factorial-count greedy covers all cases
